Absorbative.desc: 20% chance to reduce an attack by 5% per rank. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Aftershock.desc: After dealing 50,000 damage, create an explosion centered on your current target, dealing up to 40% per rank to nearby enemies.

Antitheism.desc: Denies access to protect prayers/deflect curses.

Biting.desc: +2% chance per rank to critically hit opponents. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Blunted.desc: Reduces the weapon's damage by 1% per rank.

Breakdown.desc: When finishing a smithing item has a 0.8% chance per rank, of giving components as if you would've dissassembled the item. This does not dissassemble the item.

Brief Respite.desc: Reduces cooldown for Guthix's Blessing and Rejuvenate by 5% per rank, and total healing by 1% of max lifepoints per rank.

Bulwark.desc: Debilitate deals no damage but gains up to 6% per rank extra duration from shield value.

Butterfingers.desc: Has a 3% chance per rank of dropping the resource you have just gathered. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Careless.desc: While mining, increases your damage by 2% per rank, at the cost of reducing your stamina by an additional 10% per rank. While smithing, increases your base progress per strike by 10% per rank, at the cost of reducing heat by an additional 10% per rank.

Caroming.desc: Ricochet deals 4% bonus damage per rank, with each hit. Abilities copied with Chain deal an additional 5% + 5% damage per rank against secondary targets.

Cautious.desc: Cannot auto-retaliate while this item is equipped.

Charitable.desc: Has a 1% chance per rank of putting an extra item by other nearby players after successfully gathering a resource. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Cheapskate.desc: Has a 1% chance per rank of transmuting a gathered resource to a lower tier.

Clear Headed.desc: Anticipation lasts one additional second per rank, but no longer reduces damage taken.

Committed.desc: Always skulled while this item is equipped. This perk is currently disabled.

Confused.desc: Has a 1% chance per rank of teleporting you randomly after successfully gathering a resource.

Crackling.desc: Periodically zaps your combat target for 50% per rank of your weapon's damage (or 10% per rank in PvP). (1 minute cooldown)

Crystal Shield.desc: Has a 10% chance to activate on taking damage, lasting 10 seconds. 5% of damage taken per rank is totalled for this period, becoming temporary lifepoints afterwards. These last either 30 seconds or until depleted through further damage. (1 minute cooldown) This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Demon Bait.desc: Damage to demons is reduced by 30%.

Devoted.desc: 3% chance per rank on being hit that protection prayers will work at 100% (or 75% in PvP) for 3 seconds. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Efficient.desc: Charge drain rate for this item is reduced by 6% per rank.

Energising.desc: Gain by 50 + 25 per rank accuracy bonus.

Enhanced Devoted.desc: 4.5% chance per rank on being hit that protection prayers will work at 100% (or 75% in PvP) for 3 seconds. This does not stack with devoted. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Enhanced Efficient.desc: Charge drain rate for this item is reduced by 9% per rank. This does not stack with efficient.

Enlightened.desc: +3% item XP per rank (for the item it's installed on).

Equilibrium.desc: Ability damage is increased by 6%, plus an additional 2% per rank, but prevents critically striking. (Cannot critically strike for 30s after unequipping this perk).

Eruptive.desc: Ability damage is increased by 0.5% per rank.

Explosive.desc: While mining core rocks, your mining damage is increased by 20%, but rockertunities will no longer spawn.

Fatiguing.desc: Gain 2% less adrenaline per rank from all attacks.

Flanking.desc: Soul Strike, Backhand, Impact and Binding Shot no longer stun and deal 40% more damage per rank to targets that are not facing you.

Fortune.desc: Has a 0.5% chance per rank on gathering skills and 0.1% chance per rank on production skills to double and bank what you have gathered or produced.

Furnace.desc: Has a 5% chance per rank of consuming a gathered resource for an extra 100% XP. When mining has a 5% chance per rank to generate no progress, but give double xp. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Genocidal.desc: Deal up to +5% extra damage to your current Slayer target proportional to progress through your current task.

Glow Worm.desc: Provides light equivalent to a bullseye lantern.

Hallucinogenic.desc: Causes you to see strange things...

Hasty.desc: During excavation gives a 1% chance per rank to gain triple excavation progress, at the cost of not receiving a material.

Hoarding.desc: Protect Item protects two items instead of one. (Does not work in PvP areas.)

Honed.desc: Has a 2% per rank higher chance of successfully gathering items. However, while mining you have a 2% chance per rank of mining an additional ore. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Imp Souled.desc: Has a 3% chance per rank on successful gathering to send the gathered resources to the bank at a cost of 30 prayer points. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Impatient.desc: 9% chance per rank for basic abilities to generate 3 extra adrenaline. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Inaccurate.desc: Reduces the weapon's accuracy by 1% per rank.

Invigorating.desc: Boosts adrenaline gained from basic attacks by 5% per rank.

Junk Food.desc: Food gives 3% less health per rank.

Looting.desc: Most enemies have a 25% chance to drop an additional high-level resource. (5 minute cooldown.)

Lucky.desc: 0.5% chance per rank when hit that the damage dealt will be reduced to 1. Does not stack with the equivalent Warpriest effect. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Lunging.desc: The damage of Combust and Dismember is increased by + an additional per rank.

Mediocrity.desc: Reduces maximum hit by 3% per rank.

Mobile.desc: Reduces cooldown of Surge, Escape, Dive, Bladed Dive, Barge and Greater Barge by 50%.

Naturalist.desc: When successfully gathering from a Woodcutting, Mining or Fishing resource, gives a 0.5% chance per rank to activate a random skill specific buff.

Oblivious.desc: Increases the number of successive pickpockets you can make by 5 before your target starts to get more suspicious.

Planted Feet.desc: The duration of Sunshine and Death's Swiftness is increased by 25%, but they no longer deal periodic damage to your target.

Polishing.desc: Has a 3% chance per rank of transmuting a gathered resource to a higher tier. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Precise.desc: Increases your minimum damage by 1.5% per rank of your maximum damage.

Preparation.desc: Preparation's duration and cooldown are increased by 15% per rank.

Preservationist.desc: On excavation completion has a 1% chance per rank to gain a restored artefact instead of a damaged artefact.

Profane.desc: You are prevented from drinking prayer potions.

Prosper.desc: Allows you to find clue scrolls whilst skilling and a 1% chance for elite clues found this way to be upgraded to master. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Pyromaniac.desc: Has a 0.1% chance per rank of burning all logs of the same type from the inventory. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Rapid.desc: Has a 5% chance per rank to carry out work at a faster pace. However, while smithing has a 5% chance per rank to double your progress while your heat is lost twice as fast. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Refined.desc: Has a 5% chance per rank of preventing a resource depleting when gathering. However, while mining increases your chance to find geodes by 2% per rank. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Reflexes.desc: Anticipation's duration and cooldown are halved.

Relentless.desc: 1% chance per rank to prevent adrenaline being consumed when using an ability that requires adrenaline. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Ruthless.desc: Whenever you defeat an enemy you gain a 0.5% damage boost per rank for 20 seconds. This can stack up to 5 times. (Does not work in PvP areas.)

Scavenging.desc: 1% chance per rank to get an uncommon Invention component as a drop from combat (with a 1% chance it will be a rare component instead). This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Scraps.desc: Gain one additional resource when a material cache is depleted or a tree is felled.

Shield Bashing.desc: Debilitate's damage is increased by 15% per rank.

Spendthrift.desc: 1% chance per rank to deal 1% extra damage per rank, at the cost of 1 gold coin per extra point of damage dealt. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Taunting.desc: Provoke affects enemies in a 5x5 square around its target, causing those that are already in combat to attack you.

Tinker.desc: Has a 5% chance per rank to carry out higher quality work, awarding an extra 25% XP. While smithing, has a 2% chance per rank to double your progress. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Trophy-taker's.desc: 3% chance per rank a slain creature will add zero kills to its Slayer assignment; 2% chance per rank it will add 2 kills. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items.

Turtling.desc: The Barricade ability's duration and cooldown are both increased by 10% per rank.

Ultimatums.desc: Ultimate abilities gain base damage per rank.

Undead Bait.desc: Damage to undead is reduced by 30%.

Wild Runes.desc: Has a 1% chance per rank to channel the Ourania Altar, providing a random assortment of elemental and catalytic runes in place of those you would have gained at the altar you are using. (Does not work when crafting necrotic runes.)

Wise.desc: While equipped, +1% per rank additional experience, up to 50,000 XP per day.
